test: PNRO09/1260 hardware-free Meta-context view-headroom boundary test

mechanism.binding_constraint: ggml object pool (ggml_new_object enforces ctx->mem_size); the headroom bounds tensor-object METADATA, not model data (per PNRO09 plan note)
mechanism.per_view_object: one fixed GGML_TENSOR_SIZE metadata object (simple tensor in stc_compute context, no_alloc=true -> obj_alloc_size=0)
mechanism.capacity: N views fit iff N * GGML_TENSOR_SIZE <= compute_headroom * S  =>  N_max = compute_headroom * S / GGML_TENSOR_SIZE (proportional to headroom)
mechanism.test_design: static leaf t (size S) in USER ctx -> stc_static; N between-eval view tensors of t in a separate ctx (pool sized N*(S+2048) so its own pool is not the binding constraint) registered via buf->iface.init_tensor -> stc_compute[0]; probe N to find N_max

A: 89 fit, 90 fail; B: 445 fit, 446 fail (needed 164128 > available 163840 = 80*2048)

implied_ggml_tensor_size.note: N_max = headroom*S/obj_size; both S values imply obj_size ~ 366 bytes (the fixed metadata object)

results.ratio_patched_over_unpatched: ~5.0 (80/16), confirmed at two independent S values
results.safe_failure_evidence: ggml_new_object: not enough space in the context's memory pool (needed 164128, available 163840) -- the bounded safe-failure abort when the compute container is exceeded
results.metadata_cost: stc_compute mem_size = compute_headroom * S; 80x vs 16x the static mem_size (bounded, linear in headroom; metadata objects only, no model data)

conclusion: The 1260 patch (compute_headroom 16 -> 80) increases the Meta compute-container view capacity by a factor of ~5 (80/16), confirmed by the observed N_max at two independent S values (ratio 5.045 and 5.0), with a bounded, linear metadata cost and a safe abort on capacity exceedance. This is a capacity (correctness-scoped) result, not a performance claim.
